title: Calls for More Enforcement Actions at Roads that are Prone to Car Racing
what_it_is: Calls for More Enforcement Actions at Roads that are Prone to Car Racing

sections.label: Illegal speed trials penalties enforcement
sections.summary: TP assesses public feedback, mounts enforcement operations, and sets fines, mandatory imprisonment and vehicle forfeiture for illegal speed trials, with case numbers from 2015 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Further, when public feedback is received on such activities, TP will also assess and where necessary mount additional enforcement operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The penalties for conducting illegal speed trials include a fine, mandatory imprisonment and forfeiture of the vehicle.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: First-time offenders are liable for a fine not less than $1,000 and not more than $2,000 and mandatory imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Repeat offenders are liable for a fine not less than $2,000 and not more than $3,000 and mandatory imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police may seize the vehicle used in the illegal speed trials and the Court may order its forfeiture.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From 2015 to 2017, there were five cases of illegal speed trials and 10 persons were convicted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There were four cases from 2018 to 2020, involving 31 persons arrested, which are pending investigations or court proceedings.

sections.label: Feedback on illegal speed trials
sections.summary: Feedback was received on illegal speed trial issues in the Member's constituency, and enforcement operations have been and continue to be conducted.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For the Member's concern, we have received feedback relating to some of the issues that she faced in her constituency in relation to illegal speed trials.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have been and continue to conduct enforcement operations.
